paper_title: On the Impact of Singleton Strategies in Congestion Games
statement: Our work leaves two open problems. The first is to understand whether better performance is possible for approximate one-round walks in weighted symmetric load balancing games (we conjecture this is not the case), while the second is to give upper bounds on the performance of one-round walks in weighted and unweighted load balancing games with identical resources.
